title: EFQM: Journey to Excellence (J2E)
overview: What does excellence truly mean? What are the fundamental principles organizations must adopt to achieve it? Are there clear criteria that organizations can use to evaluate their progress? And how can continuous improvement be sustained across all aspects of an organization? The EFQM Excellence Model was created to address these questions.

This course explores the EFQM Excellence Model and its three core components, providing participants with the tools to assess their organization's current level of excellence and identify areas for strategic enhancement. Through group activities and practical exercises, participants will gain a comprehensive understanding of the model, preparing them to drive continuous improvement in their organizations.
audience: This course is designed for professionals, leaders, supervisors, and anyone involved in quality management, organizational excellence, and performance improvement. It is especially beneficial for individuals participating in efforts to achieve national or international quality awards based on the EFQM model.
methodology: The course combines interactive workshops, group reflections, and practical exercises to ensure participants understand and apply the EFQM concepts. It also introduces the "Quick Check" Excel-based assessment tool, enabling participants to perform rapid evaluations of their organization's performance.
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Use self-assessment as a tool for driving organizational improvement.
Develop a strategic roadmap and actionable plans for organizational improvement.
Prioritize improvement actions for optimal resource utilization.
Create plans to engage team members in the improvement process.
Apply tools and techniques to enhance organizational performance.
Understand EFQM’s levels of excellence and align organizational goals and aspirations.
Address cultural aspects of excellence to strengthen intangible assets.
